label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_ConfirmPokemonPrize
body:
bufferspeciesname STR_VAR_1, VAR_0x8004
	msgbox MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ConfirmPokemonPrize, MSGBOX_YESNO
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, NO, MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_ChoosePokemonPrizeMessage
	checkcoins VAR_TEMP_2
	goto_if_lt VAR_TEMP_2, VAR_0x8006, MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_NotEnoughCoinsForPokemon
	special GiveEmeraldChampionsGameCornerPokemon
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, EC_GAME_CORNER_PRIZE_ALREADY_CAUGHT, MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_AlreadyCaughtLegendary
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, MON_CANT_GIVE, MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_NoRoomForPokemon
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, EC_GAME_CORNER_PRIZE_SET_FAILED, MauvilleCity_GameCorner_EventScript_PokemonPrizeSetFailed
	removecoins VAR_0x8006
	updatecoinsbox
	playse SE_SHOP

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_EventScript_ReceiveFossilMon
body:
bufferspeciesname STR_VAR_2, VAR_TEMP_TRANSFERRED_SPECIES
	msgbox RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife, MSGBOX_DEFAULT
	copyvar VAR_0x8004, VAR_TEMP_TRANSFERRED_SPECIES
	setvar VAR_0x8005, 20
	special GiveEmeraldChampionsPreparedPokemon
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, MON_GIVEN_TO_PARTY, RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_EventScript_ReceiveFossilMonParty
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, MON_GIVEN_TO_PC, RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_EventScript_ReceiveFossilMonPC
	goto Common_EventScript_NoMoreRoomForPokemon
	end

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_EventScript_GiveBeldum

	special GiveEmeraldChampionsPreparedPokemon

	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, MON_GIVEN_TO_PC, MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_EventScript_SendBeldumPC
